Reference

Requirements for production completeness

This page lists every requirement of the production pages added to close the gaps found by the production-completeness audit (grant expiry, refusals and changes, audit of grant events, unattended grants, helper and server death, out-of-band kill, resource limits, registry shutdown, user reports, air-gapped transfer, configuration export, compliance and audit collection, bad-release response, text direction and input, colour and no-colour, non-text panes, language coverage, API change proposals, CI report formats, conformance claims, test strategy and SDK pinning). The statement is the owner bullet word for word. Change the bullet first, then copy it here.

Id Statement Page Testable how
PDX-001 A plugin project MUST commit its lockfile (Cargo.lock for Rust, bun.lock for TypeScript), and a release build or ilium plugin check --release without one MUST fail with build.unpinned-inputs as defined by [DEV-893]. guide-pinning-the-sdk Delete Cargo.lock from a Rust template project and run ilium plugin check --release: the exit code is non-zero and the output contains build.unpinned-inputs.
PDX-002 The templates MUST pin the SDK to a tilde-style minor range (Rust ilium-plugin-sdk = "~0.4.2", TypeScript "~0.4.2"), and ilium plugin check MUST warn with lint.sdk-range-open for any requirement that admits a higher minor, such as *, ^0.4 or a bare major. guide-pinning-the-sdk Change the SDK requirement in package.json to ^0.4.2 and run ilium plugin check: the output contains one lint.sdk-range-open warning naming package.json.
PDX-003 dist/build.json MUST record the resolved SDK version together with the lowest and highest host API minors that SDK declares, and ilium plugin build MUST fail with build.sdk-host-mismatch when the manifest api is outside that range. guide-pinning-the-sdk Set manifest api to a minor one above the resolved SDK's highest declared host minor and run ilium plugin build: the exit code is non-zero, the output contains build.sdk-host-mismatch, and no dist/ package is written.
PDX-004 When one plugin uses both the Rust and the TypeScript SDK, they MUST resolve to the same SDK line (same major.minor), otherwise ilium plugin build MUST fail with build.sdk-line-mixed. guide-pinning-the-sdk Pin the Rust SDK to ~0.4.2 and the TypeScript SDK to ~0.5.0 in one project and run ilium plugin build: the output contains build.sdk-line-mixed and the exit code is non-zero.
PDX-005 A patch bump within a pinned SDK line MUST NOT change any exported signature (per [API-083] and [API-086]), so an author MAY accept patch updates automatically, while a minor bump MUST be made in its own commit with ilium plugin check re-run. guide-pinning-the-sdk Resolve the SDK from 0.4.2 to 0.4.3 in the lockfile and rebuild without source changes: the build succeeds and the exported WIT interface hash in dist/build.json is unchanged.
PDX-006 ilium plugin check MUST fail with lint.sdk-deprecated as an error when the resolved SDK minor equals or exceeds the removal minor of an item the plugin still uses ([DEV-997]), so the pin is moved only after the item is replaced. guide-pinning-the-sdk Use an item whose removal minor is 0.5 and pin the SDK to ~0.5.0: ilium plugin check exits non-zero and prints lint.sdk-deprecated with the item name and the removal minor.
PDY-001 ilium plugin grant --until <timestamp> MUST accept only RFC 3339 UTC timestamps and MUST refuse a time in the past or more than 365 days ahead with exit code 2 and the code grant.expiry-invalid. reference-grant-expiry Run ilium plugin grant example.sync fs.read --until 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z: the exit code is 2, the output contains grant.expiry-invalid, and the grant store is unchanged.
PDY-002 The host MUST compare the expiry against a monotonic-corrected wall clock at the start of every capability call, not only on a timer. reference-grant-expiry Set an expiry 2 seconds ahead, stop the host timers in the harness, and make a call 3 seconds later: the call returns not-permitted with reason revoked.
PDY-003 A call that started before the expiry and is still running when it passes MUST return not-permitted with reason revoked, and the grant epoch MUST bump once. reference-grant-expiry Start a long fs.read stream 1 second before expiry: the stream ends with not-permitted reason revoked and ilium plugin grants example.sync --json shows the epoch incremented by exactly 1.
PDY-004 If the system clock moves backwards, a grant that has already expired MUST stay expired. reference-grant-expiry Let a grant expire, move the system clock back one day in the harness, and call the capability: the call returns not-permitted with reason revoked.
PDY-005 An expired grant MUST be shown as expired in the Plugins screen and in ilium plugin grants for 30 days and then removed from the store; re-granting MUST require the review dialog again. reference-grant-expiry After expiry, ilium plugin grants example.sync --json lists the grant with state: "expired"; after 31 days of simulated time the entry is absent, and ilium plugin grant example.sync fs.read opens the review dialog.
PDY-006 On expiry the host MUST re-activate the plugin with the reduced grant set exactly as it does for a revoke. reference-grant-expiry Let one of two grants expire: the plugin's activate export runs once more and its reported grant list contains only the remaining grant.
PDY-007 A refused call MUST return the not-permitted result with the fields grant and reason, and reason MUST be exactly one of declined, revoked, not-granted or policy. api-grant-refusal-and-changes Call fs.read from a plugin whose fs.read grant was revoked: the result is not-permitted with grant: "fs.read" and reason: "revoked" and no other fields.
PDY-008 A refusal with reason policy MUST NOT reveal which policy file, key or rule matched. api-grant-refusal-and-changes Deny net.fetch for the plugin in the system policy file and call it: the result carries reason: "policy" and the serialized result contains no file path, key name or rule id.
PDY-009 A refused call MUST return within 50 ms and MUST NOT open a prompt unless the grant is defined with first-use consent. api-grant-refusal-and-changes Call an un-granted capability without first-use consent 100 times in the harness: every call returns not-permitted in under 50 ms and the harness records zero prompts.
PDY-010 The host MUST deliver the plugin event grant-set-changed within 1 s of each epoch bump, carrying only the added and removed grant names and the new epoch; it is distinct from the server-to-client grants-changed control record. api-grant-refusal-and-changes Revoke fs.read with the CLI while the plugin runs: within 1 s the plugin's event handler receives grant-set-changed with removed: ["fs.read"], added: [] and the new epoch, and no other keys.
PDY-011 A plugin MUST be able to read its current grant set through grants.current, and the result MUST list only grants its manifest requests, never grants it was not offered. api-grant-refusal-and-changes Call grants.current from a plugin whose manifest requests fs.read and clipboard.read while the user holds other plugins' grants: the result contains at most those two names with their states.
PDY-012 A plugin MUST NOT retry a call refused with reason declined, revoked or policy until it receives a grant-set-changed event that adds the grant, and the host MUST return not-permitted without a prompt on such retries. api-grant-refusal-and-changes Retry a call refused as declined ten times without an intervening grant event: every retry returns not-permitted with reason declined and the harness records zero prompts.
PDY-013 grant-given and grant-revoked records MUST carry actor.kind (one of user-tui, cli, policy, expiry), grant, previous_state and epoch. reference-audit-grant-events Revoke fs.read with ilium plugin grants example.sync --revoke fs.read and read the last audit line: event is grant-revoked, actor.kind is cli, grant is fs.read, previous_state is held and epoch equals the new epoch.
PDY-014 Revoke all MUST write one grant-revoked record per grant plus exactly one revoke-all summary record carrying the count. reference-audit-grant-events Run ilium plugin grants example.sync --revoke-all on a plugin holding three grants: the audit log gains three grant-revoked lines and one revoke-all line with count: 3.
PDY-015 The audit catalogue MUST include grant-expired with plugin_id, grant, expired_at and detected_at, written once per expiry. reference-audit-grant-events Let a grant expire and make five calls afterwards: exactly one grant-expired line exists for it, with expired_at equal to the stored expiry and detected_at at or after it.
PDY-016 A grant refused by policy at install time MUST write one grant-policy-denied record per install attempt, naming the grant. reference-audit-grant-events Install a plugin requesting a policy-denied grant twice: the audit log contains exactly two grant-policy-denied lines, each with the grant name.
PDY-017 Declining a row in the review dialog MUST write one grant-declined record with the grant name. reference-audit-grant-events Decline the net.fetch row during install: the audit log contains one grant-declined line with grant: "net.fetch".
PDY-018 Refused runtime calls for grants that are not HIGH MUST be summarised into at most one grant-refused record per plugin and grant per minute, carrying count; HIGH grants keep their per-call records. reference-audit-grant-events Make 500 refused clipboard.read calls within 10 seconds: the audit log contains exactly one grant-refused line for that plugin and grant with count: 500.
PDY-019 A grant change made by the CLI in a non-interactive session MUST record the invoking uid in actor.uid. reference-audit-grant-events Run ilium plugin grants example.sync --revoke fs.read from a shell without a controlling terminal: the grant-revoked line has actor.kind: "cli" and actor.uid equal to the shell's uid.
PDY-020 Every grant audit record MUST be reachable with ilium plugin audit --event <name> --plugin <id> --json, printing one JSONL line per record. reference-audit-grant-events Run ilium plugin audit --event grant-revoked --plugin example.sync --json after one revoke: the output is exactly one JSON line whose event is grant-revoked.
PDY-021 ilium plugin grant <id> <grant> for a HIGH grant without an attached client MUST fail with exit code 3 and the code grant.needs-interactive, unless a policy allow-list names that plugin and grant. reference-grant-cli-unattended With no client attached and no allow-list, run ilium plugin grant example.sync shell.exec: the exit code is 3, the output contains grant.needs-interactive, and ilium plugin grants example.sync --json does not list shell.exec.
PDY-022 ilium plugin grants <id> --revoke <grant> MUST work without an attached client and MUST exit 0 only after the epoch bump has been written to the grant store. reference-grant-cli-unattended With no client attached, run the revoke and immediately read the grant store file: the epoch is incremented and the command exited 0.
PDY-023 Every grant command MUST print exactly one JSONL result line with the fields type, plugin_id, grant and epoch. reference-grant-cli-unattended Run ilium plugin grants example.sync --revoke fs.read --json: stdout is one JSON line with keys type, plugin_id, grant and epoch and nothing else.
PDY-024 A first-use consent that would prompt in a headless session MUST resolve as declined, return not-permitted with reason declined, and write a grant-declined audit record with actor.kind: "policy". reference-grant-cli-unattended Trigger a first-use consent capability in a server with no client attached: the call returns not-permitted reason declined and the audit log gains one grant-declined line with actor.kind: "policy".
PDY-025 Revoking a grant the plugin does not hold MUST exit 4 with the code grant.not-held and MUST change nothing, including the epoch. reference-grant-cli-unattended Run ilium plugin grants example.sync --revoke net.fetch when net.fetch is not held: the exit code is 4, the output contains grant.not-held, and the epoch in the grant store is unchanged.
PDZ-001 Each helper MUST set PR_SET_PDEATHSIG to SIGKILL before it reads any plugin bytes, so that SIGKILL of the server ends every helper within 1 s. reference-helper-orphan-and-server-death Start a server with two active plugins, send SIGKILL to the server pid, and list processes 1 s later: no process whose command line names a helper for that server pid remains.
PDZ-002 A helper MUST also exit within 2 s when its dispatcher channel reaches end-of-file, as a fallback for hosts without parent-death signals. reference-helper-orphan-and-server-death Close the dispatcher socket of a running helper from the server side without killing the server: the helper pid is gone within 2 s and its exit status is 0.
PDZ-003 At start the server MUST scan for helper cgroup leaves left by a previous boot id or server pid, kill their processes and remove the leaves before activating any plugin. reference-helper-orphan-and-server-death Create a stale leaf containing a sleeping process under the helper cgroup path pattern and start the server: the process is gone and the leaf directory is removed before the first plugin.activated log line.
PDZ-004 Each stale helper found at start MUST be logged with the code host.helper-orphan-reaped and written to the audit log as one helper-orphan-reaped record with the plugin id and the previous server pid. reference-helper-orphan-and-server-death After the stale-leaf start, the log contains one host.helper-orphan-reaped line and ilium plugin audit --event helper-orphan-reaped --json prints one line with plugin_id and previous_server_pid.
PDZ-005 A helper MUST NOT survive more than 5 s after the server pid is gone, whatever the cause of the server's exit. reference-helper-orphan-and-server-death Kill the server with SIGKILL while a plugin runs a busy loop, wait 5 s, and check: no helper pid remains and the helper cgroup leaf is empty.
PDZ-006 The next start MUST NOT count reaped orphans as plugin failures in the three-failure window. reference-helper-orphan-and-server-death Reap one orphan at start, then run ilium plugin health example.sync --json: the failures_in_window field is 0.
PDZ-007 ilium plugin kill <id> --reason <text> MUST fall back, after 2 s without a server reply, to writing the kill state file and sending cgroup.kill to the plugin's helper cgroup leaf, and MUST print which path (server or offline) it used. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server Stop the server loop with SIGSTOP and run the kill command: within 3 s it exits 0, prints path: offline, and the helper pid is gone.
PDZ-008 A kill state file written while the server is stopped MUST be honoured at the next start before any activation of that plugin, leaving it in state disabled-by-admin. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server With the server stopped, run ilium plugin kill example.sync --reason test, start the server, and run ilium plugin list --json: the plugin's state is disabled-by-admin and no plugin.activated log line exists for it.
PDZ-009 Helper cgroup leaves MUST follow the documented path pattern <ilium cgroup>/helpers/<plugin-id>/ so an operator can find them by plugin id, and cgroup.kill written to that leaf MUST be treated by the server as one counted helper failure. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server Write 1 to cgroup.kill of .../helpers/example.sync/ while the plugin runs: the helper exits, ilium plugin health example.sync --json shows failures_in_window: 1, and the leaf path matches the pattern.
PDZ-010 When run under a supervisor (--supervised), the server MUST write a heartbeat file every 1 s and MUST exit with status 70 if its main loop has not ticked for 30 s, beyond the host.loop-stalled detection of [HST-618]. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server Run the server with --supervised and block its loop in the harness for 31 s: the heartbeat file stops updating and the server process exits with status 70.
PDZ-011 An offline kill MUST write one plugin.killed audit record with the field path set to offline, written at the next start if the server was not running. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server After an offline kill and a restart, ilium plugin audit --event plugin.killed --plugin example.sync --json prints one line with path: "offline".
PDZ-012 A kill by any path MUST NOT call any export of the plugin, including its deactivate export. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server Kill a plugin whose deactivate export writes a marker file: after the kill the marker file does not exist.
PDZ-013 ilium plugin disable --all-third-party --reason <text> ([SEC-457]) MUST stop every non-core plugin within 1 s on the server and within 5 s on each attached client without restarting the server, and MUST print the ids of the core plugins it skipped. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server Run the command with three third-party and two core plugins active: within 1 s the server reports all three as disabled-by-admin, the command output lists the two core ids under skipped, and the server pid is unchanged.
PDZ-014 ilium plugin enable --all-third-party ([SEC-458]) MUST re-enable plugins one at a time in install order and MUST stop at the first plugin that fails its grant review, printing that plugin id and leaving later plugins disabled. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server Disable all, then decline the grant review of the second plugin in install order during re-enable: the first is enabled, the second and third remain disabled-by-admin, and the output names the second plugin.
PDZ-015 Both commands MUST work in safe mode and with no network available. ops-out-of-band-kill-and-stuck-server Start the server in safe mode with networking disabled in the harness and run ilium plugin disable --all-third-party --reason test: the exit code is 0 and the state file lists every third-party plugin as disabled-by-admin.
PDZ-016 Every limit MUST have exactly one row giving its default, manifest key, hard host cap, enforcement mechanism and the exact error code (trap.memory, trap.deadline, host.stack-overflow, quota-exceeded, helper.unstable or another named code). reference-resource-limits-matrix Parse the matrix table on the published page: each of memory, cpu, time, stack, processes, fds and disk appears once, and every row has a non-empty value in all six columns.
PDZ-017 Exhausting the Wasm stack MUST trap with the code host.stack-overflow and MUST count as one failure in the three-failure window. reference-resource-limits-matrix Call an export that recurses without bound: the result is a trap with code host.stack-overflow and ilium plugin health <id> --json shows failures_in_window: 1.
PDZ-018 Reaching pids.max MUST return busy with the reason process-limit to the plugin on the spawning call, as defined by [SEC-039], and MUST NOT kill the helper. reference-resource-limits-matrix Spawn child processes until the limit is reached: the failing spawn returns busy with the reason process-limit, the helper pid is unchanged and the plugin keeps answering calls.
PDZ-019 A limit breach that kills the helper MUST be logged with the limit name and the observed value at the time of the breach. reference-resource-limits-matrix Allocate past the memory limit: the log line for the kill contains limit: memory and an observed byte count at or above the configured limit.
PDZ-020 Each row MUST state whether a breach counts toward the three-failure window, and the host behaviour MUST match that column. reference-resource-limits-matrix For the fds row, which states that the breach does not count: open file descriptors past the limit and check that failures_in_window stays 0.
PDZ-021 The matrix MUST be generated from the same source as the host constants, and a test MUST fail when the published table and the constants differ. reference-resource-limits-matrix Change the default memory limit constant in the host source without regenerating the page and run the manual tests: the drift test fails naming the memory row.
PDW-001 An operator ending service MUST publish a signed sunset notice in snapshot.json at least 180 days before the last signed timestamp.json expires. publish-registry-shutdown-and-migration Verify a snapshot carrying sunset.ends_at less than 180 days before the final timestamp expiry with ilium plugin registry doctor: it reports registry.sunset-too-short.
PDW-002 During the freeze the registry MUST serve existing metadata and packages read-only and MUST refuse publish, yank and owner changes with registry.read-only. publish-registry-shutdown-and-migration Run ilium plugin publish against a registry in freeze: the exit code is non-zero and the output contains registry.read-only, while ilium plugin install of an existing package still succeeds.
PDW-003 Once a sunset notice is verified, a client MUST show registry ending on <date> in ilium plugin list and ilium plugin registry doctor, and MUST NOT block install, update or removal. publish-registry-shutdown-and-migration Point a client at a registry with a verified sunset notice and run ilium plugin list: the output contains registry ending on followed by the date, and ilium plugin install of a listed package exits 0.
PDW-004 A handover to a new operator MUST be published as a root.json version signed by the threshold of the previous root keys, and a client MUST refuse a new root not so signed with registry.root-invalid. publish-registry-shutdown-and-migration Serve a root.json version 3 signed only by new keys: ilium plugin registry doctor reports registry.root-invalid and the pinned root stays at version 2.
PDW-005 After the last timestamp expires, a client MUST report registry.metadata-expired, refuse new installs and updates from that registry, and keep installed plugins running without deleting them. publish-registry-shutdown-and-migration Advance the clock past the final timestamp expiry: ilium plugin update exits non-zero with registry.metadata-expired and ilium plugin list still shows the installed plugin as enabled.
PDW-006 A URL move MUST be a url field in a root.json version signed by the current root, and the client MUST re-pin the new URL only after the user confirms in a prompt, never from an HTTP redirect. publish-registry-shutdown-and-migration Serve an HTTP 301 from the old registry URL to a new host: the client keeps the old pinned URL and registry doctor reports registry.redirect-ignored; with a signed url change the client prompts and re-pins only after y.
PDW-007 A mirror MUST keep serving the last verified snapshot after the upstream shutdown and MUST label it frozen in its sync report. publish-registry-shutdown-and-migration Run ilium plugin mirror sync --json against an upstream that has shut down: the output line has status: "frozen" and the mirror still serves the last snapshot's packages.
PDW-008 ilium plugin report <id> --submit MUST print the exact JSON payload and require explicit confirmation before any request is sent; without --submit the command MUST print the contacts and send nothing. user-reporting-a-plugin Run ilium plugin report example.sync with network capture on: no request is made; run it with --submit and answer n: the payload was printed and still no request is made.
PDW-009 The payload MUST contain only the plugin id, version, package sha256, one policy.json rule id, a category and a free text of at most 4000 characters, and MUST NOT contain the host name, user name, file paths or the list of other installed plugins. user-reporting-a-plugin Submit a report and inspect the captured request body: its keys are exactly plugin_id, version, sha256, rule_id, category and text, and text longer than 4000 characters is refused before sending with report.text-too-long.
PDW-010 The client MUST refuse a rule id not present in the cached policy.json with report.rule-unknown and exit code 2. user-reporting-a-plugin Run ilium plugin report example.sync --submit --rule no-such-rule: the exit code is 2, the output contains report.rule-unknown and no request is sent.
PDW-011 The intake MUST answer with a report id, the client MUST store it locally, and ilium plugin report --status <report-id> MUST fetch and print the recorded decision or pending. user-reporting-a-plugin Submit a report, then run ilium plugin report --status <id>: the output is one JSON line with report_id and decision set to pending or the recorded value.
PDW-012 The registry MUST accept at most 10 reports per client token per day and MUST answer excess reports with HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header, which the client MUST print as report.rate-limited with the wait time. user-reporting-a-plugin Submit 11 reports with one token in a day: the 11th receives HTTP 429 with Retry-After, and the client prints report.rate-limited with the number of seconds.
PDW-013 A report with category vulnerability MUST be redirected to the plugin's security_contact and the registry security contact, and MUST NOT be filed as an abuse report. user-reporting-a-plugin Run ilium plugin report example.sync --category vulnerability --submit: the output prints both security contacts and no abuse report request is sent.
PDW-014 The reporter identity MUST NOT appear in any public document, including the transparency log entry for the decision ([PUB-045]). user-reporting-a-plugin Fetch the transparency log entry for a decided report: it contains the report id and decision but no token, email or client identifier.
PDV-001 ilium plugin bundle create --out <file> MUST write a single archive holding the package files, their signatures and the signed registry metadata, plus a bundle.json listing the SHA-256 of every member. guide-air-gapped-transfer Create a bundle for two installed plugins and list the archive: it contains two package files, their signature files, the metadata files and a bundle.json whose members has one SHA-256 per other member.
PDV-002 ilium plugin bundle import <file> MUST verify every member hash and every signature before copying anything into the package source named in packages.allowed_sources, and on any mismatch MUST copy nothing and exit with code 3. guide-air-gapped-transfer Flip one byte in a package inside a bundle and import it: the exit code is 3, the output names the member, and the allowed package source directory is unchanged.
PDV-003 A bundle MUST NOT carry registry root keys, and import MUST refuse with bundle.root-not-pinned a bundle whose metadata is signed by a root key not pinned under [PKG-985]. guide-air-gapped-transfer Import a bundle signed by an unpinned root on a client with a different pinned root: the exit code is 3 and the output contains bundle.root-not-pinned.
PDV-004 When the signed metadata expires time has passed, installs from the bundle MUST be refused with reason metadata-expired, and already installed plugins MUST keep running. guide-air-gapped-transfer Advance the clock past the bundle metadata expires and run ilium plugin install --from-bundle: the exit code is non-zero with metadata-expired, and ilium plugin list still shows existing plugins as enabled.
PDV-005 A bundle carrying a revocation list newer than the stored one MUST apply it at import and write one trust.key-revoked audit record per newly revoked key. guide-air-gapped-transfer Import a bundle whose revocation list adds two keys: the audit log gains exactly two trust.key-revoked lines, each with a key id.
PDV-006 Import MUST write one bundle-import audit record with the bundle SHA-256, the member count and the result. guide-air-gapped-transfer After a successful import, ilium plugin audit --event bundle-import --json prints one line with sha256, member_count and result: "ok".
PDV-007 Importing a bundle whose metadata version is older than the stored metadata version MUST be refused with reason rollback and exit code 3. guide-air-gapped-transfer Import a bundle with snapshot version 4 after version 5 is stored: the exit code is 3 and the output contains rollback.
PDV-008 ilium plugin config export --out <file> MUST write a TOML file with version = 1, mode 0600, listing plugin ids, exact versions and each plugin's non-secret settings. reference-config-export-import Export on a machine with two plugins and inspect the file: it starts with version = 1, stat shows mode 0600, and it contains both plugin ids with their exact versions.
PDV-009 The export MUST NOT contain secrets, keyring entries, grants, consent records or the per-plugin random identifier. reference-config-export-import Store a secret and hold grants for a plugin, then export: the file contains no key named secret, grants, consent or instance_id and none of the secret's bytes.
PDV-010 ilium plugin config import <file> MUST validate the whole file against every plugin's settings schema before applying anything, and on any error MUST apply nothing and exit with code 2. reference-config-export-import Import a file with one valid plugin section and one setting of the wrong type: the exit code is 2, the output names the invalid key, and neither plugin's settings changed.
PDV-011 Import MUST skip any key the admin policy locks, list it as locked in its output, and MUST NOT modify the policy file. reference-config-export-import Lock example.sync.interval in the system policy and import a file setting it: the output lists the key with locked, the setting keeps the policy value, and the policy file hash is unchanged.
PDV-012 ilium plugin config import --dry-run <file> MUST print each change as one JSONL line and MUST write nothing. reference-config-export-import Run the dry run against a file that changes three settings: stdout has three JSON lines with plugin_id, key, old and new, and the settings store hash is unchanged.
PDV-013 Import of a file whose version is higher than the supported version MUST fail with reason config-version-unsupported and exit code 2. reference-config-export-import Import a file with version = 2 on a client supporting version 1: the exit code is 2 and the output contains config-version-unsupported.
PDV-014 Each export and import MUST write one audit record of event config-export or config-import with the byte count and file count in detail and no setting values. reference-config-export-import Export then import, and read the audit log: one config-export and one config-import line exist, each with detail.bytes and detail.files, and neither contains any exported setting value.
PDV-015 ilium plugin policy status --json MUST print policy_sha256 of the system file, loaded_at, schema_version, the origin (system or user) of each effective key, and the count of ignored files. guide-policy-compliance-reporting Run the command on a machine with a system policy and a stricter user file: the JSON has policy_sha256, loaded_at, schema_version, an origins map with system or user per key, and ignored_files as an integer.
PDV-016 policy_sha256 MUST be the SHA-256 of the system policy file bytes as read at start, and MUST equal the after hash of the latest policy-reloaded audit record. guide-policy-compliance-reporting Compute sha256sum of the system policy file right after start: it equals policy_sha256 from the status command and the after field of the last policy-reloaded audit line.
PDV-017 When the file on disk differs from the loaded hash, the command MUST report pending_restart: true and exit with code 4. guide-policy-compliance-reporting Append a comment line to the system policy file while the server runs and run the status command: the JSON has pending_restart: true and the exit code is 4.
PDV-018 If the system file was ignored under [SEC-182], the command MUST report policy: "ignored" with the reason and exit with code 3. guide-policy-compliance-reporting Make the system policy file world-writable and start the server: the status command prints policy: "ignored" with reason naming the permission problem and exits 3.
PDV-019 The status command MUST read only local files and MUST NOT open any network connection. guide-policy-compliance-reporting Run the command under a network namespace with no interfaces: it exits with the same output and code as with networking available.
PDV-020 The output MUST NOT include notice text or user-file values that are not stricter than the system file. guide-policy-compliance-reporting Set a looser value for a key in the user file and run the status command: the JSON contains the system value only and no notice field.
PDV-021 A collector MUST key records by machine id plus seq and MUST treat a repeated pair arriving with a different record hash as tampering. guide-audit-collection Replay a record with the same machine id and seq but a changed detail: the reference collector raises a tamper alert naming the machine id and seq.
PDV-022 A collector MUST raise a gap alert when seq skips a value or when prev_hash does not equal the hash of the previous accepted record. guide-audit-collection Drop one record from a forwarded stream: the reference collector raises a gap alert with the expected and received seq.
PDV-023 Central retention MUST be at least the host audit.keep_days value (default 365). guide-audit-collection Configure the reference collector with retention 30 days against a host with audit.keep_days = 365: its configuration check fails with retention-below-host.
PDV-024 Each syslog message MUST be one JSON object of at most 8192 bytes, and a record exceeding that MUST be truncated in detail only, with truncated: true added. guide-audit-collection Write an audit record with a 20 KiB detail and capture the syslog message: it is one JSON object of at most 8192 bytes, detail is shortened, truncated is true, and every other field is intact.
PDV-025 The documented minimum alert set MUST include records with event policy-violation, signature-failure, blocklist-hit and integrity-failure. guide-audit-collection Load the published alert rule file into the reference collector and forward one record of each of the four events: four alerts fire, one per event.
PDV-026 Collectors MUST order records by seq, never by ts, because the host clock may move backwards. guide-audit-collection Forward records whose ts decreases while seq increases: the reference collector stores them in seq order and raises no reorder alert.
PDU-001 The publisher MUST run ilium plugin yank <id>@<version> --reason <text> within 1 hour of confirming a Level 1 or Level 2 defect. guide-bad-release-recall-playbook Read the incident record of a Level 1 defect: the yank timestamp is at most 60 minutes after the recorded confirmation timestamp.
PDU-002 A yank reason MUST begin with security: for a security defect and with defect: otherwise, and the registry MUST refuse any other prefix with yank.reason-prefix. guide-bad-release-recall-playbook Run ilium plugin yank example.sync@1.2.0 --reason "bad build": the exit code is non-zero and the output contains yank.reason-prefix; with --reason "defect: bad build" it exits 0.
PDU-003 The hotfix MUST carry a higher version number than the yanked release, because a lower one is refused with package.downgrade. guide-bad-release-recall-playbook Publish 1.1.9 after yanking 1.2.0: the publish exits non-zero with package.downgrade; publishing 1.2.1 exits 0.
PDU-004 A hotfix MUST NOT raise data_version unless it ships a migration from the yanked version's data, because rollback is otherwise refused with migration.data-newer. guide-bad-release-recall-playbook Run ilium plugin check on a hotfix that raises data_version without a migration from the previous value: the output contains lint.hotfix-data-version as an error.
PDU-005 The publisher MUST keep the previous good version downloadable so that ilium plugin rollback <id> has a target. guide-bad-release-recall-playbook After the yank, run ilium plugin rollback example.sync on a machine with the bad version: the exit code is 0 and ilium plugin list shows the previous good version.
PDU-006 The incident record MUST list every offline mirror and bundle the publisher knows of, because a yank does not reach a bundle already copied, and each MUST be marked refreshed or outstanding. guide-bad-release-recall-playbook Read the incident record template section Mirrors and bundles: every listed entry has a refreshed or outstanding mark and a date.
PDU-007 The post-incident record MUST be written within 5 working days and MUST name the detection time, yank time, hotfix time and the number of installs affected. guide-bad-release-recall-playbook Validate a post-incident record with ilium plugin incident check <file>: it exits non-zero naming any missing one of detected_at, yanked_at, hotfix_at or installs_affected.
PDU-008 The operator MUST contain first, by adding the plugin id to plugins.deny_ids or the version to the file named by packages.blocklist_file, before any investigation. ops-bad-release-fleet-response Read the incident record: the Actions taken line for the deny or blocklist entry carries a time earlier than the first investigation entry.
PDU-009 Containment MUST be recorded as an Actions taken line with time and administrator, as the incident runbook requires. ops-bad-release-fleet-response Validate the incident record with ilium plugin incident check <file>: it fails with incident.action-unrecorded when the blocklist change has no Actions taken line with a time and an administrator.
PDU-010 The operator MUST identify affected machines from the install, update and update.rolled-back audit records collected centrally, not by asking users. ops-bad-release-fleet-response Query the collector for install and update records naming the bad version: the result lists every machine id that installed it, and the incident record's machine list equals that result.
PDU-011 Recovery by lockfile MUST use ilium plugin sync --locked, which downgrades to the locked version without --allow-downgrade ([USR-048]). ops-bad-release-fleet-response Pin the good version in the fleet lockfile and run ilium plugin sync --locked on a machine with the bad version: the exit code is 0 and ilium plugin list shows the good version.
PDU-012 A machine whose plugin data is newer than the old version MUST recover with ilium plugin rollback <id> --restore-backup, and the operator MUST first verify the archive with ilium plugin restore <file> --dry-run. ops-bad-release-fleet-response On a machine whose data_version was raised by the bad release, run the dry run and then the rollback with --restore-backup: the dry run exits 0 listing the archive members and the rollback exits 0 with the old version running.
PDU-013 The incident MUST NOT be closed until every machine in scope reports the fixed version in ilium plugin list or reports the plugin as denied. ops-bad-release-fleet-response Run ilium plugin incident check <file> with one in-scope machine still reporting the bad version: it exits non-zero with incident.machine-outstanding and the machine id.
PDU-014 Level 1 incidents MUST be acknowledged within the severity table's time, and the operator MUST attach a support bundle built with ilium plugin support-bundle <id> only after the [OPS-006] attach check passes. ops-bad-release-fleet-response Attach a support bundle without the OPS-006 check recorded: ilium plugin incident check <file> exits non-zero with incident.bundle-unchecked.
PDT-001 The host MUST draw RTL runs in logical order, left to right in cells, and MUST NOT reorder or mirror characters. guide-bidirectional-text-and-control-characters Render the fixture string abc שלום in a plugin view with the harness: the cells left to right contain a,b,c,,ש,ל,ו,ם.
PDT-002 The host MUST replace each of U+202A to U+202E and U+2066 to U+2069 in every plugin-supplied string drawn on an approval, permission or install prompt with one U+FFFD cell, consistent with [SEC-104] for names. guide-bidirectional-text-and-control-characters Pass a path containing U+202E to an approval prompt: the rendered prompt shows U+FFFD in that position and the prompt text contains no code point in U+202A..U+202E or U+2066..U+2069.
PDT-003 Truncation MUST NOT split a grapheme cluster or a combining sequence and MUST place the ellipsis … in the last cell. guide-bidirectional-text-and-control-characters Render a 10-cell label whose 10th cell would fall inside the cluster é: the output ends with … at cell 10 and the preceding cells contain only whole clusters.
PDT-004 ilium plugin lint MUST report ui.bidi-control for any literal bidi control character in a manifest string or catalogue message. guide-bidirectional-text-and-control-characters Put U+202E in a manifest title and run ilium plugin lint: the output contains ui.bidi-control naming the title key.
PDT-005 Names shown in the permission dialog MUST be rendered with bidi controls stripped, and ilium plugin inspect <id> --json MUST expose the raw unstripped value. guide-bidirectional-text-and-control-characters Install a plugin whose title contains U+202E: the dialog shows the stripped title and ilium plugin inspect <id> --json returns the title with the U+202E code point present.
PDT-006 While a composition is active the host MUST NOT run plugin commands bound to printable keys. guide-text-input-and-composition Bind a command to j, start a composition in the harness and send j as preedit: the command's invocation count stays 0 until the composition is committed or cancelled.
PDT-007 A text-input change event MUST carry only the committed string, never preedit text. guide-text-input-and-composition Compose に through preedit n,i and commit: the plugin receives exactly one change event whose value ends with に and no event containing n or ni.
PDT-008 A bracketed paste MUST arrive as one change event of up to 1 MiB, and a larger paste MUST be truncated to 1 MiB with the notice code input.paste-truncated. guide-text-input-and-composition Paste 2 MiB with bracketed paste in the harness: the plugin receives one change event with a 1 MiB value and the harness records one notice input.paste-truncated.
PDT-009 A wide character MUST advance the cursor by two cells, and the harness MUST ship a fixture that checks this. guide-text-input-and-composition Type 漢 into an empty input: the cursor cell index reported by the harness is 2, and the fixture fixtures/input-wide-cursor passes.
PDT-010 An input maxlength MUST be counted in grapheme clusters, not bytes or code points. guide-text-input-and-composition Set maxlength: 3 and type é, 漢, a, b: the value after the fourth keystroke contains exactly three clusters and b is refused.
PDT-011 Cursor movement in a plugin text input MUST move exactly one grapheme cluster per Left or Right key press. guide-text-input-and-composition Put the cursor after éx and press Left twice: the cursor is at index 0 and the first press moved it before x.
PDT-012 With NO_COLOR set to any non-empty value the host MUST emit no colour escape sequences for plugin text and MUST keep bold, underline and reverse attributes. guide-colour-depth-and-no-color Run a plugin view in the harness with NO_COLOR=1 and capture the output: it contains no SGR colour parameters (30-37, 38, 40-47, 48, 90-97, 100-107) and still contains the bold sequence for a bold span.
PDT-013 An rgb colour on a 256-colour terminal MUST map to the nearest xterm-256 index by CIE76 distance in CIELAB. guide-colour-depth-and-no-color Render rgb(250, 128, 114) with --colour-depth 256: the emitted index is 209, the nearest xterm-256 entry by CIE76.
PDT-014 At monochrome depth the host MUST show the danger role as bold plus the literal prefix text the plugin supplied, never by colour alone. guide-colour-depth-and-no-color Render a danger span with prefix ! at --colour-depth 8 mono: the output contains the bold sequence and the literal ! before the text, and no colour sequence.
PDT-015 The harness MUST accept --colour-depth 8|16|256|truecolor for render checks and MUST refuse any other value with exit 2 and usage.invalid-value. guide-colour-depth-and-no-color Run ilium plugin test --colour-depth 64: the exit code is 2 and the output contains usage.invalid-value; --colour-depth 16 runs and reports depth 16 in the report file.
PDT-016 ilium plugin lint MUST report ui.colour-only-state when two declared states of one widget differ only by a role colour. guide-colour-depth-and-no-color Declare two badge states with identical text and glyph and different role colours: ilium plugin lint prints ui.colour-only-state naming the widget.
PDT-017 A scene or glyph-plane pane MUST declare a description of 1 to 200 characters in its manifest, and install MUST refuse a manifest without one with manifest.description-missing. a11y-non-text-panes Install a scene plugin whose manifest lacks description: the exit code is non-zero and the output contains manifest.description-missing.
PDT-018 In screen-reader mode the host MUST print the description and the current scene state line instead of cells. a11y-non-text-panes Enable screen-reader mode and open a scene pane in the harness: the linear output contains the manifest description followed by the plugin's state line and no cell grid.
PDT-019 With reduced motion on, a scene MUST be limited to at most 1 frame per second or one static frame. a11y-non-text-panes Enable reduced motion and run a scene for 10 s in the harness: the frame counter is at most 10.
PDT-020 Every scene control MUST be reachable with the keyboard only, and ilium plugin lint MUST reject a mouse-only control with ui.mouse-only-control. a11y-non-text-panes Declare a scene control with a pointer binding and no key binding: ilium plugin lint prints ui.mouse-only-control naming the control.
PDT-021 A scene MUST NOT convey required information in cells alone; every required state MUST appear in the state line. a11y-non-text-panes Change the scene to an alert state in the harness: the state line returned by scene.state changes in the same frame as the cells.
PDT-022 Language sources MUST be applied in the order --language, ILIUM_LANG, [ui] language, LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG, then en. reference-language-resolution-and-coverage Start with LANG=fr_FR.UTF-8, ILIUM_LANG=de and --language ja: ilium plugin i18n-coverage --json reports language: "ja"; without the flag it reports de.
PDT-023 ilium plugin i18n-coverage MUST print one JSONL line per installed plugin with plugin_id, language, message_count and missing_count, and MUST exit 0. reference-language-resolution-and-coverage Run the command with two plugins installed: stdout has two JSON lines, each with those four keys, and the exit code is 0.
PDT-024 A catalogue larger than 256 KiB MUST be refused with i18n.catalogue-too-large, and the plugin MUST still load with English messages. reference-language-resolution-and-coverage Install a plugin with a 300 KiB de catalogue and start with ILIUM_LANG=de: the log contains i18n.catalogue-too-large and the plugin's messages render in English.
PDT-025 A language change MUST re-render every open plugin view within 500 ms. reference-language-resolution-and-coverage Open two plugin views and change [ui] language from en to fr: the harness observes both views redrawn with French messages within 500 ms.
PDT-026 The administrator policy key [ui] language_locked MUST pin the language for all plugins, overriding every other source. reference-language-resolution-and-coverage Set language_locked = "en" in the system policy and start with --language fr: ilium plugin i18n-coverage --json reports language: "en" for every plugin.
PDT-027 A change to a WIT interface, a capability, a limit listed in Errors and limits, or a manifest key MUST be filed as a proposal numbered P<n> before any merge. governance-api-change-proposals Open a pull request changing a WIT file without a Proposal: P<n> line in its description: the repository check fails with governance.proposal-missing.
PDT-028 A proposal MUST state the problem, the alternatives considered, the effect on existing packages, and, if it deprecates anything, the marking minor and the removal minor. governance-api-change-proposals Validate a proposal file lacking the Alternatives section with the proposal template check: it fails naming Alternatives.
PDT-029 A proposal containing a breaking change MUST stay open for comment at least 30 days before the owner of the affected requirement prefix decides. governance-api-change-proposals Attempt to mark a breaking proposal accepted 20 days after it was opened: the template check fails with governance.comment-period-open and the days remaining.
PDT-030 The outcome MUST be exactly one of accepted, rejected, withdrawn or superseded, and an accepted proposal MUST create a D<n> entry on Design decisions within 7 days. governance-api-change-proposals Set the outcome field to approved: the template check fails listing the four allowed values; an accepted proposal older than 7 days without a D<n> reference fails with governance.decision-missing.
PDT-031 A proposal MUST NOT change a contract in a patch release. governance-api-change-proposals Tag a patch release whose changelog references an accepted proposal that changes a WIT interface: the release check fails with governance.contract-change-in-patch.
PDT-032 A rejected proposal MUST record its reason and MUST NOT be reopened without new evidence cited in a Reopened because section. governance-api-change-proposals Change a proposal from rejected to open without a Reopened because section: the template check fails with governance.reopen-unjustified.
PDT-033 ilium plugin test-report <report.json> --format junit --out <path> MUST write a JUnit XML file with one testcase element per case in the native report. guide-ci-test-report-formats Convert a native report with 12 cases: the XML parses, and count(//testcase) is 12.
PDT-034 A fail or trap status MUST map to a failure element, skipped to a skipped element, and a case with flaky: true MUST map to a passing testcase carrying a property flaky with value true. guide-ci-test-report-formats Convert a report containing one fail, one skipped and one flaky case: the XML has one failure, one skipped, and one testcase with <property name="flaky" value="true"/> and no failure child.
PDT-035 The JUnit file MUST NOT contain absolute paths, user names or wall-clock timestamps, so output from different machines compares equal ([DEV-890]). guide-ci-test-report-formats Convert the same native report on two machines with different users and home directories: the two XML files are byte-identical.
PDT-036 An unknown --format value MUST fail with exit code 2 and usage.invalid-value. guide-ci-test-report-formats Run ilium plugin test-report report.json --format tap: the exit code is 2 and the output contains usage.invalid-value.
PDT-037 A native report from an interrupted run (exit 130) MUST still convert to a well-formed JUnit file carrying the testsuite property complete with value false. guide-ci-test-report-formats Interrupt a run with SIGINT and convert its report: the XML parses and contains <property name="complete" value="false"/>.
PDT-038 The conformance suite report MUST convert with the same command and formats, using the case id as the testcase name. guide-ci-test-report-formats Convert a test --conformance report: every testcase name attribute equals a conformance case id of the form C-<n>.
PDT-039 A conformance claim MUST name the contract ilium:plugin@0.1.0, the suite version, the subject, and the pass, skip and fail counts by case id. reference-conformance-claims Validate a claim file missing suite_version with ilium plugin verify-conformance: the exit code is 2 and the output names suite_version.
PDT-040 A claim MUST be invalid if any counted case has a retired id or if any case failed. reference-conformance-claims Verify a report that counts a retired case id: the exit code is non-zero with conformance.retired-case; verify a report with one fail: the exit code is non-zero with conformance.case-failed.
PDT-041 A claim MUST be re-run and re-published within 90 days of a new suite minor, otherwise verification MUST mark it stale. reference-conformance-claims Verify a claim made against suite 1.2 when suite 1.3 was released 91 days ago: the output has status: "stale".
PDT-042 A report MUST include the SHA-256 of the component or host build under test, and the signed report MUST cover that hash. reference-conformance-claims Remove the subject_sha256 field from a report: ilium plugin verify-conformance exits 2 naming the field.
PDT-043 ilium plugin verify-conformance <report> MUST exit 3 when the subject hash does not match the provided artefact and exit 2 on malformed input. reference-conformance-claims Run the command with --subject pointing at a different build: the exit code is 3 with conformance.hash-mismatch; run it on a non-JSON file: the exit code is 2.
PDT-044 A claim MUST NOT use the Ilium name or logo beyond the wording the governance page permits, and the published claim template MUST contain only that wording. reference-conformance-claims Validate a claim whose statement differs from the permitted wording: the template check fails with conformance.wording-invalid.
PDT-045 A release MUST have at least one fixture per declared command, view and hook, otherwise ilium plugin check --release warns with lint.untested-contribution naming each uncovered contribution. guide-plugin-test-strategy Declare two commands and write a fixture for one: ilium plugin check --release prints one lint.untested-contribution warning naming the other command.
PDT-046 Every requested grant MUST have one fixture that runs with the grant held and one that expects capability.denied with the grant absent. guide-plugin-test-strategy Request fs.read with only a granted fixture: ilium plugin check --release prints lint.grant-denial-untested naming fs.read.
PDT-047 A quarantined case ([DEV-960]) MUST carry an expires date at most 14 days ahead, and a run after that date MUST fail with test.quarantine-expired. guide-plugin-test-strategy Quarantine a case with expires 31 days ahead: ilium plugin test exits 2 with test.quarantine-too-long; run with a quarantine whose date has passed: the run exits non-zero with test.quarantine-expired.
PDT-048 The release gate MUST run ilium plugin test --conformance against the packed component in dist/, not a debug build. guide-plugin-test-strategy Run ilium plugin check --release after building only a debug component: it fails with release.conformance-not-packed.
PDT-049 A case flagged flaky ([DEV-963]) in three consecutive runs MUST fail the release gate with test.flaky-persistent. guide-plugin-test-strategy Record three consecutive reports in which case sync-retry is flaky: true and run ilium plugin check --release: it exits non-zero with test.flaky-persistent naming sync-retry.
